dominant_strengths: Section labels (Settings, Account, Preferences) attempt a basic information hierarchy through bold weight differentiation
Form contains the expected primitive set: text inputs, checkboxes, select, textarea, covering settings scope
dominant_weaknesses: Catastrophic spatial composition: fields float at random x-offsets, overlap, and have inconsistent widths with no grid or alignment logic
Mixed typographic systems (monospace placeholders, sans labels, varying sizes) produce visual noise without intentional contrast or rhythm
Zero visual grouping, no cards, dividers, or whitespace strategy; checkboxes scatter across the canvas disconnected from their labels
fix_priorities: Establish a single left-aligned column with consistent field width, vertical rhythm, and clear section grouping via cards or rules
Unify typography to one family with a defined scale; reserve monospace only for technical values if needed
Pair every checkbox tightly with its label and align controls to a baseline grid
Introduce hierarchy through spacing tokens and subtle dividers rather than scattered placement
rationale.norman_balance: Fails on all three Norman levels: visceral is broken by chaotic layout, behavioral is hampered by ambiguous label-control pairing, and reflective offers no sense of trust or product identity.
rationale.intent_fit: It nominally surfaces settings fields but the broken layout makes the form nearly unusable, so it does not solve the brief credibly.
